request.subject: ICON:ACTION:KABOOM

layers.text: Make the bomb ball jet black with dark charcoal grey shading instead of slate blue-grey, and make the spark at the fuse tip pale cream-white with no orange. Change nothing else: keep the round shape, the band, the fuse cap, the cream fuse, outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background.
